about.en: FTRB is the token of Faith Tribe, a collaborative fashion design platform founded by the owners of the streetwear brand Faith Connexion, where independent designers co-create, produce and sell physical and digital garments and are rewarded in FTRB. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x2596825a84888e8f24b747df29e11b5dd03c81d7, with a Polygon deployment at 0xc3f56d567e7663e8932e65d85ae4be7eb5575ca7.
